faehigkeiten.grund: Auslieferung wird je Abruf neu zusammengesetzt (megaphone vergibt je Abruf eine request_event_id, megaphone haengt ein timetoken an, Adresse traegt eine session_id, kein ETag und Cache-Control "max-age=0, no-cache, no-store", Abruf laeuft ueber den Werbedienst megaphone.fm) - Byte-Offsets veralten (bei dynamischer Auslieferung sofort, gemessen 19.08.2026) und die Zeitachse verschiebt sich mit (eine Folge war 57 s kuerzer als 3,5 h zuvor), deshalb sind auch Sprungmarken in Sekunden unsicher

einzeiler: Joe Rogan discusses conspiracies, tech, history, and current events with guests.
kurzfassung: Joe Rogan sits down with his guests to cover a wide range of topics, including internet security flaws, historical conspiracies, and the cultural impact of modern technology. They explore unconventional theories about historical figures, secret government operations, and the evolution of artificial intelligence. Throughout the conversation, they mix humor and speculation while discussing everything from ancient myths to modern media trends.
stichpunkte: Discussion on recent PHP programming language vulnerabilities and security flaws.
Exploration of historical assassination theories, including Vince Foster and Gary Webb.
Debating the reality of the war on drugs and non-lethal border weapon testing.
Analysis of bizarre internet content directed at children, often dubbed Elsagate.
Reflections on the cultural impact of smartphones and excessive daily screen time.
Speculation on secret government bioweapon testing and historical military experiments.
Conversations surrounding Elizabeth Holmes, Theranos, and the nature of grifting.
Debates on the plausibility of non-human intelligence, ancient giants, and lost history.
Critique of modern media curation, Cambridge Analytica, and online propaganda.

clips.text: Looking at historical documentation revealing extensive secret tests involving simulated biological weapons conducted across American cities.
A humorous moment where a guest jokingly worries about angering powerful tech executives over critical comments made on the show.
Discussing advanced radar-based security systems capable of screening tens of thousands of people per hour at public events.
